column1: # DT-019 review queue: the 132 UN international days added to dataset/international/un-international-days.json on
# 2026-09-23 (R07/D-05, ADR-0042) with a machine-translated Persian title marked `titleReview: ["fa"]`, because no
# primary Persian source (UNIC Tehran or the United Nations in Iran) names them. This file used to be a sourcing
# blocker (these days were excluded from the dataset); it is now a review queue: each row is a record already
# shipped, whose `fa` title still needs a human reviewer, ideally checked against a native Persian source when one
# appears. Reviewing a row means editing the record's `fa` title in the dataset and removing "fa" from its
# `titleReview` array (docs/i18n/TRANSLATING.md's `MT: needs review` marker is the same idea for app strings).

# the archived UN Information Centre Tehran list (2012-10-05) and every reachable Persian page of iran.un.org and of the UNIC Tehran archive were searched on 2026-09-18; these days are named on none of them

# 2026-09-23 (R07/D-05 re-check, docs/data-todo/un-days-sourcing.md): iran.un.org's newest posts (through 2026-09-21) were re-checked and name no day of this list; two days newly proclaimed since the 2026-09-18 pass were added: World Turkic Language Family Day (un.world-turkic-language-family-day, UNESCO 2025) and International Day of Recognition for Women Searchers of Missing Persons (un.women-searchers-missing-persons-day, UN GA 2026) — both too recent for a Persian source to exist yet

# the 10 international weeks on the UN list are now shipped as `Week` rule records (ADR-0046, DT-041, 2026-09-24); like the 132 days above, none has an official Persian source, so each carries a machine-translated title and is queued below for review: un.interfaith-harmony-week, un.racism-solidarity-week, un.immunization-week, un.non-self-governing-week, un.breastfeeding-week, un.science-and-peace-week, un.amr-awareness-week, un.media-information-literacy-week, un.space-week, un.disarmament-week
# Vesak (UN GA res. 54/115) is tracked separately as DT-040: its blocker is a missing rule type (the day of the full moon in May), not a missing Persian title
